item.title: Version 0.8.0
item.description:
Added

  • Ask ADSwift — smarter assistant. Parallel tool calls for faster answers, a Stop button to interrupt mid-turn, and a smart synthesis gate that skips post-processing when it’s not needed. The composer can now sit as a floating pill so it stays out of your way until you need it.
  • Keyword ROAS leaderboard tool. Ask “what are my best-performing keywords?” and ADSwift returns a joined Apple Ads + RevenueCat ROAS report, grouped one row per local-keyword match with unattributed revenue split out.
  • Org-wide revenue rollup in chat. Questions like “which app made the most revenue this week?” now actually answer across every connected app instead of just the active one.
  • Screen-aware chat context. When you’re on an app’s screen, the assistant automatically pulls in that app’s RevenueCat numbers so you don’t need to re-state which app you mean.
  • CSV export. Export the current table — campaigns, ad groups, keywords, or search terms — to CSV.
  • Progressive revenue loading in All Campaigns. Revenue rows now fill in app-by-app as each one’s data arrives, instead of every row waiting for the slowest app.
  • Offline awareness. The app notices when the network drops and stops hammering the API; calls resume cleanly when you’re back online.

Changed

  • Faster and more accurate revenue in chat. Chat tools that report on revenue, ROAS, and keyword performance now match the figures shown in the tables, with attribution-source filtering applied correctly — organic and other-source revenue no longer leak in.
  • Friendlier chat error bubbles. Known provider failures (rate limits, auth issues, network) get a one-liner you can act on instead of a wall of stack trace.
  • Cleaner chat transcripts. Legacy “[agent thinking…]” status text is scrubbed from saved messages and no longer shows up in new ones.

Fixed

  • Revenue values now appear on first visit to Ad Groups and Keywords. Previously, opening Ad Groups (or Keywords) from a campaign you’d just been viewing left the Revenue column empty until you navigated to the next level and back. Fixed.
  • Sidebar no longer squeezed on first install. Fresh installs were rendering the left panel too narrow, clipping “All Campaigns” and “Connect to Apple Ads”. Now lands at a sensible width on first launch.
  • Rows don’t reshuffle while All-Campaigns revenue is loading. Sort order is held steady during the progressive load and re-applies once everything’s in.
  • No more crashes from case-variant keyword names in the ROAS rollup. Two keywords that differed only in casing used to trip a deduplication bug; both now collapse into one row.
